name: CRISPR Delivery Strategy Advisor
description: Recommends and ranks CRISPR delivery methods (lipofection, electroporation, RNP, AAV, lentiviral, etc.) for a given cell type and Cas variant, with rationale and key considerations for each.

inputs.name: cell_type
inputs.description: The target cell type for CRISPR editing (e.g. 'HEK293', 'primary T cells', 'neurons', 'iPSCs', 'hepatocytes').

inputs.name: edit_type
inputs.description: The type of genome edit to perform (e.g. 'knockout', 'knock-in', 'base edit', 'prime edit'). Defaults to 'knockout' if not provided.

outputs.description: A ranked list of delivery methods with suitability ratings, rationale, and key considerations, plus a top recommendation and general advice.

ranked_methods.rationale: HEK293 cells are highly transfectable with lipid-based reagents. Plasmid delivery of SpCas9 and sgRNA is simple and cost-effective for knockout.
Pre-assembled Cas9 RNP complexes offer rapid editing with minimal off-target activity due to transient presence.
Provides stable expression but carries integration risk, which is unnecessary for simple knockouts.

result.general_advice: For HEK293 knockouts with SpCas9, lipofection is the simplest and most cost-effective approach. Consider RNP electroporation if off-target minimization is critical.

ranked_methods.rationale: Primary T cells are resistant to lipofection but respond well to electroporation. RNP format avoids DNA toxicity in primary immune cells.
key_considerations: Standard method for T cell engineering

ranked_methods.rationale: Can deliver Cas9 efficiently but introduces integration risk, which may be undesirable for therapeutic applications.
AAV has limited cargo capacity and SpCas9 exceeds the packaging limit, making it unsuitable for this combination.
key_considerations: SpCas9 exceeds AAV packaging limit (~4.7 kb)

result.general_advice: RNP electroporation is the gold standard for editing primary T cells with SpCas9. Optimize electroporation parameters for your specific T cell subtype and activation state.
